# Decoder test fixtures

Each file is 0.3 s of a 440 Hz sine tone, stereo, 44.1 kHz: no recording of
anything. They were generated once with:

    ffmpeg -f lavfi -i "sine=frequency=440:duration=0.3:sample_rate=44100" -ac 2 -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 64k -f mp3 tone.mp3.bin
    ffmpeg -f lavfi -i "sine=frequency=440:duration=0.3:sample_rate=44100" -ac 2 -c:a flac -f flac tone.flac.bin
    ffmpeg -f lavfi -i "sine=frequency=440:duration=0.3:sample_rate=44100" -ac 2 -c:a libvorbis -q:a 3 -f ogg tone.ogg.bin

`tone.mp3.bin` is the same file as `../sdkcontract/testdata/tone.mp3.bin`.
`ffmpeg` is not run by any test or make target. The `.bin` suffix keeps tools
from treating them as music.

`composed-long.flac.bin` is the composed tests' long FLAC object (M3b2,
plan v7 §7, F1a-F1c): 24 s of two independent pink-noise channels, stereo,
44.1 kHz, 16-bit, 3,222,311 bytes (more than four 512 KiB chunks, so a
chunk-0 read can prefetch chunks 1-3). It was generated once, on
2026-10-15, with ffmpeg n9.0.1, by:

    ffmpeg -nostdin -hide_banner -loglevel error -f lavfi -i "anoisesrc=color=pink:amplitude=0.25:sample_rate=44100:seed=20261015:duration=24" -f lavfi -i "anoisesrc=color=pink:amplitude=0.25:sample_rate=44100:seed=20261016:duration=24" -filter_complex "[0:a][1:a]join=inputs=2:channel_layout=stereo[a]" -map "[a]" -map_metadata -1 -fflags +bitexact -flags:a +bitexact -c:a flac -sample_fmt s16 -compression_level 5 -f flac composed-long.flac.bin

SHA-256 `21224254b44d90a6502f3431929481e93a8df9bd043ce04c5bce154b149fe385`;
a second run of the same command gave the same bytes, and `flac -t` passes.
Like the others, it is never generated by a test or a make target.
